mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, summary, content, category, tags, publish_date, update_date, view_count, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{category}, #{tags, typeHandler=com.shuiqingzheng.common.util.JsonTypeHandler}, #{publishDate}, #{updateDate}, 0, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags, typeHandler=com.shuiqingzheng.common.util.JsonTypeHandler}, update_date = #{updateDate}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM article WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY publish_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM article WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 'published' ORDER BY publish_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM article WHERE status = 'published' AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY publish_date DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article WHERE status = 'published' AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
